title: The law E73 does not imply cube associativity E4380
author: Matthew Bolan, Joachim Breitner, Jose Brox, Nicholas Carlini, Mario Carneiro, Floris van Doorn, Martin Dvorak, Andr\'es Goens, Aaron Hill, Harald Husum, Hern\'an Ibarra Mejia, Zoltan A. Kocsis, Bruno Le Floch, Amir Livne Bar-on, Lorenzo Luccioli, Douglas McNeil, Alex Meiburg, Pietro Monticone, Pace P. Nielsen, Emmanuel Osalotioman Osazuwa, Giovanni Paolini, Marco Petracci, Bernhard Reinke, David Renshaw, Marcus Rossel, Cody Roux, J\'er\'emy Scanvic, Shreyas Srinivas, Anand Rao Tadipatri, Terence Tao, Vlad Tsyrklevich, Fernando Vaquerizo-Villar, Daniel Weber, Fan Zheng
work: The Equational Theories Project: Advancing Collaborative Mathematical Research at Scale
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs an infinite magma satisfying E73 while violating E4380. Its specific obligation is to select a collision-avoiding rule set (right-translation injectivity and exclusion of fixed right values), add the new products a*b=c and, when forced, a*c=d without breaking that rule set, verify the four possible new-rule cases, and preserve an explicit four-element seed violating E4380. The retained author proof of the abstract greedy theorem supplies the countable extension-to-total-operation step. These compatibility and countermodel-construction steps are proved here, rather than inferred from the paper title or delegated to an automated prover.
